1: #!/usr/bin/env -S npx tsx
2: /**
3:  * Condition-aware piece evaluation. Value (an odds match) is one number; this tool asks the other
4:  * questions the owner raised: does a piece ever get paralysed? Does its contribution change with the
5:  * army's composition — guards, pawns, screens? Is a cheap piece balance-breaking in the right
6:  * condition? Does a dear piece go quiet in the wrong one?
7:  *
8:  *   tsx tools/conditions.ts --runs np-N,np-O,np-V-ortho,np-T
9:  *   tsx tools/conditions.ts --pair np-V-ortho,np-N          # paired by gameId (same openings)
10:  *
11:  * Per run it prints, for every piece type the run contains:
12:  *   presence   count/share of games where either army starts with the type
13:  *   owner armies  the count of separate armies that start with it
14:  *   moves per owner  the piece's moves per owner army
15:  *   still      share of owner armies where it made no move at all (paralysis)
16:  *   type present at end  share of owner armies with that type at the end; promotions can
17:  *                        replace original individuals, whose survival is not measured
18:  * and per run: decisive share, draws, capped, mean plies, White score.
19:  *
20:  * `--pair A,B` adds the paired difference over shared gameIds (same seed and ranks in the lab's
21:  * matched runs), plus the run's interaction counters so a condition can be read from the moves.
22:  */
23: import { createReadStream, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
24: import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
25: import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
26: import { LETTERS } from '../src/rules/engine';
27: import type { GameRecord } from '../src/sim/game';
28: 
29: const flag = (name: string, dflt: string): string => {
30:   const i = process.argv.indexOf(`--${name}`);
31:   return i >= 0 && process.argv[i + 1] ? process.argv[i + 1] : dflt;
32: };
33: const RUNS = flag('runs', '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
34: const PAIR = flag('pair', '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
35: const pathOf = (id: string): string => (id.includes('/') ? id : `sim/out/${id}.jsonl`);
36: 
37: interface PieceStat {
38:   owners: number;
39:   present: number;
40:   moves: number;
41:   zero: number;
42:   survived: number;
43:   captures: number;
44: }
45: interface RunStat {
46:   id: string;
47:   games: number;
48:   decisive: number;
49:   draws: number;
50:   capped: number;
51:   plies: number;
52:   white: number;
53:   pieces: Map<string, PieceStat>;
54:   events: Record<string, number>;
55: }
56: const empty = (id: string): RunStat => ({ id, games: 0, decisive: 0, draws: 0, capped: 0, plies: 0, white: 0, pieces: new Map(), events: {} });
57: 
58: /**
59:  * One run, one piece type. A positive starting count of a valid single uppercase piece letter
60:  * (excluding K) on a side is ONE owner army for that type, no matter how many pieces of it the
61:  * side starts with — two Archers on one side are two pieces in one army, not two armies. `present`
62:  * is counted once per game: a type is present in a game if either side starts with it. `zero`
63:  * counts owner armies that made no move; `survived` counts owner armies with a positive end count;
64:  * `moves` and `captures` are summed over the armies. Activity and end-presence rates use owner
65:  * armies as their denominator; an empty run prints zero game rates and no piece rows.
66:  */
67: export async function scan(id: string): Promise<RunStat> {
68:   const file = pathOf(id);
69:   if (!existsSync(file)) throw new Error(`conditions: ${file} is missing`);
70:   const st = empty(id);
71:   const rl = createInterface({ input: createReadStream(file), crlfDelay: Infinity });
72:   for await (const line of rl) {
73:     if (!line) continue;
74:     const rec = JSON.parse(line) as GameRecord;
75:     st.games++;
76:     st.plies += rec.plies;
77:     st.white += rec.result;
78:     if (rec.result === 0.5) st.draws++;
79:     if (rec.reason === 'plyCap') st.capped++;
80:     if (rec.reason === 'checkmate' || rec.reason === 'adjudicatedResign') st.decisive++;
81:     for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rec.events ?? {})) {
82:       const sum = Array.isArray(v) ? (Array.isArray(v[0]) ? (v as number[][]).flat().reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) : (v as number[]).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)) : 0;
83:       st.events[k] = (st.events[k] ?? 0) + sum;
84:     }
85:     const seen = new Set<string>();
86:     for (const side of [0, 1] as const) {
87:       const pst = rec.stats[side];
88:       for (const [letter, count] of Object.entries(pst.start ?? {})) {
89:         if (!(count > 0) || !/^[A-Z]$/.test(letter) || !LETTERS.includes(letter) || letter === 'K') continue;
90:         const p = st.pieces.get(letter) ?? { owners: 0, present: 0, moves: 0, zero: 0, survived: 0, captures: 0 };
91:         p.owners += 1;
92:         if (!seen.has(letter)) { seen.add(letter); p.present += 1; }
93:         const moves = pst.moves[letter] ?? 0;
94:         p.moves += moves;
95:         if (moves === 0) p.zero += 1;
96:         if ((pst.survived[letter] ?? 0) > 0) p.survived += 1;
97:         p.captures += pst.captures[letter] ?? 0;
98:         st.pieces.set(letter, p);
99:       }
100:     }
101:   }
102:   return st;
103: }
104: 
105: const pct = (x: number): string => `${(100 * x).toFixed(1)}%`;
106: const show = (st: RunStat): void => {
107:   const g = st.games || 1;
108:   console.log(`\n${st.id}: ${st.games} games · decisive ${pct(st.decisive / g)} · draws ${pct(st.draws / g)} · capped ${pct(st.capped / g)} · plies ${(st.plies / g).toFixed(0)} · White ${(st.white / g).toFixed(3)}`);
109:   const letters = [...st.pieces.keys()].sort();
110:   console.log('  piece | presence | owner armies | moves per owner | still (no move) | TYPE PRESENT AT END | captures per owner');
111:   for (const l of letters) {
112:     const p = st.pieces.get(l)!;
113:     const owners = p.owners || 1;
114:     console.log(`    ${l.padEnd(5)} | ${`${p.present}/${st.games} (${pct(p.present / g)})`.padStart(14)} | ${String(p.owners).padStart(12)} | ${(p.moves / owners).toFixed(2).padStart(15)} | ${pct(p.zero / owners).padStart(15)} | ${pct(p.survived / owners).padStart(17)} | ${(p.captures / owners).toFixed(2)}`);
115:   }
116:   console.log('  Type present at end includes promotions; it does not track survival of original pieces.');
117:   const ev = Object.entries(st.events).filter(([, v]) => v > 0).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${(v / g).toFixed(2)}`);
118:   if (ev.length) console.log(`  events/game: ${ev.join(', ')}`);
119: };
120: 
121: const main = async (): Promise<void> => {
122:   if (PAIR.length === 2) {
123:     const [a, b] = await Promise.all([scan(PAIR[0]), scan(PAIR[1])]);
124:     show(a); show(b);
125:     // Paired difference needs the records themselves, not the aggregates.
126:     const read = async (id: string): Promise<Map<number, GameRecord>> => {
127:       const m = new Map<number, GameRecord>();
128:       const rl = createInterface({ input: createReadStream(pathOf(id)), crlfDelay: Infinity });
129:       for await (const line of rl) { if (line) { const r = JSON.parse(line) as GameRecord; m.set(r.gameId, r); } }
130:       return m;
131:     };
132:     const [A, B] = await Promise.all([read(PAIR[0]), read(PAIR[1])]);
133:     const ids = [...A.keys()].filter(i => B.has(i));
134:     const mean = (xs: number[]): number => xs.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / (xs.length || 1);
135:     const ci = (xs: number[]): number => {
136:       const n = xs.length; const m = mean(xs); if (n < 2) return NaN;
137:       const v = xs.reduce((x, y) => x + (y - m) ** 2, 0) / (n - 1);
138:       return 1.959964 * Math.sqrt(v / n);
139:     };
140:     const diff = (f: (r: GameRecord) => number): [number, number] => {
141:       const xs = ids.map(i => f(A.get(i)!) - f(B.get(i)!));
142:       return [mean(xs), ci(xs)];
143:     };
144:     const [res, resCI] = diff(r => r.result);
145:     const [dec, decCI] = diff(r => (r.result !== 0.5 ? 1 : 0));
146:     const [ply, plyCI] = diff(r => r.plies);
147:     console.log(`\npaired ${ids.length} games (${PAIR[0]} minus ${PAIR[1]})`);
148:     console.log(`  result ${res >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${res.toFixed(3)} ± ${resCI.toFixed(3)} · decisive ${dec >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dec.toFixed(3)} ± ${decCI.toFixed(3)} · plies ${ply >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${ply.toFixed(1)} ± ${plyCI.toFixed(1)}`);
149:     return;
150:   }
151:   for (const id of RUNS) show(await scan(id));
152: };
153: 
154: if (import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1] ?? '').toString()) {
155:   if (!RUNS.length && PAIR.length !== 2) {
156:     console.error('usage: tsx tools/conditions.ts --runs a,b,c | --pair a,b');
157:     process.exit(2);
158:   }
159:   main().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(2); });
160: }

(End of file - total 160 lines)
</content>
